stem: A disinfectant label specifies a required contact time. What should the technician do?
choices: Follow the current approved label/SOP contact-time requirement for the task
Shorten the time if the surface looks clean
Double the concentration so contact time no longer matters
Use a memorized time from another product
rationale: Chemical use should follow the current approved label and procedure. Contact time is product/process specific and should not be replaced by memory or improvisation.
